theme: published research recommendations and project priorities
question: Which explicit recommendations from Indus archaeology, epigraphy and computation can this repository act on with current evidence?
outcome: Final polish retains 56 recommendations from 27 sources, 35 source records and nine positions; 21 of 25 requested researchers have a recommendation. F04/F53 are positions and F55 a coverage note. All 59 original identifiers have short anchors (57 selected-text matches, two visually read images). The table has 38 scoped comparisons with conservative author-group counts. Seven current-data actions have explicit scores from 12 to 6 and link D1, D2, E, G, H and the census. All attribution remains Exploratory.
challenge: Two reviews identified unsupported or overstated attributions, metadata faults and fused prose. Full transcript and several full texts remain unavailable; three roster agenda passages unresolved and Ratnagar remark outside this agenda. Windows error 112 interrupted the earlier rebuild; continuation found no truncated saved file.
remedy: Preserved 19 first-pass files and 18 reviewer witnesses. Applied second-review corrections without rebuilding source survey; separated findings/expectations from recommendations, added short anchors and dependent-author grouping, corrected scope/locator, scored bounded priorities, repaired active encoding/spacing and checked ten deterministic exports. Selected lecture captions read visibly; failed transcript routes recorded locally.
retry_when: New inspectable agenda passages, full texts or an independently read lecture transcript become available; a reviewer identifies a specific attribution error; or improved object/date/context joins permit a bounded priority test.
